title: RepUCB: Representation Learning-Based UCB for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Linear Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2604.00531v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-task representation learning exploits the shared structure among related tasks by learning a common latent representation, thereby improving sample efficiency. This paper introduces a novel approach to multi-task representation learning in heterogeneous linear bandits. We consider $T$ concurrent heterogeneous linear bandit tasks, each with feature dimension $d$, whose reward parameters share a common latent representation of dimension $r \ll \min\{d, T\}$, capturing the underlying task relatedness. We propose RepUCB, a novel Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm that leverages shared low-rank representations to enhance learning in a sample-efficient manner. Our algorithm first collects data through an exploration phase, estimates the shared representation, and then performs UCB-based learning on our proposed confidence set. translated_title: RepUCB：基于表示学习的UCB算法求解异构多任务线性老虎机问题
translated_abstract: 多任务表示学习通过学习一个共同的潜在表示来利用相关任务之间的共享结构，从而提高样本效率。本文提出了一种在异构线性老虎机中进行多任务表示学习的新方法。我们考虑T个并发的异构线性老虎机任务，每个任务的特征维度为d，其奖励参数共享一个维度为r ≪ min{d, T}的共同潜在表示，该表示捕捉了任务之间潜在的相关性。我们提出了RepUCB，一种新颖的上置信界（UCB）算法，它利用共享的低秩表示以样本高效的方式增强学习。我们的算法首先通过探索阶段收集数据，估计共享表示，然后在我们提出的置信集上执行基于UCB的学习。我们为该置信集提供了理论保证，并证明了未知的奖励参数位于……
tldr: 本文提出RepUCB算法，通过估计任务间共享的低秩潜在表示并结合置信集上的UCB学习，以样本高效的方式解决异构多任务线性老虎机问题并提供理论保证。
